claims.text: Sri Krishnaji and Sri Preethaji teach that detachment in the ordinary sense — where one withdraws from life or suppresses emotions — is not the same as living in the Beautiful State.
Detachment can sometimes become a mask for avoidance, a way to sidestep the work of inner transformation.
The Beautiful State, by contrast, is not about moving away from life but moving deeply into it with clarity, joy, and connection.
When you live in the Beautiful State, your brain begins to beat at a higher frequency, one that naturally uplifts those around you — your family, friends, even those at a distance.
This is not detachment but a profound engagement with life from a place of wholeness.
Sri Preethaji and Sri Krishnaji describe it as a state where love, calm, and intelligence flow without division.
True healing, as they point out, involves dissolving hurt to move into love — not bypassing it.
This is the essence of the Beautiful State: you meet life fully, without the armor of detachment or the turbulence of unresolved pain.
The difference, then, is one of aliveness.
Detachment can be static; the Beautiful State is dynamic, radiating and transforming.

# The Three Levels Of Oneness

## Verbatim Discourse Excerpts
If you are in an awakened state, a state of oneness, you rise beyond pain and pleasure, fear or gratification and blessings flow to those around you. Now what is oneness? At its first level, oneness is a state where there is no conflict. At its second level, oneness is a state of no disconnection. At the third and ultimate level, there is no separation or division.

At the first level, when you are conflicting emotions and desires subside and the painful war in your mind stops, you experience the first level of oneness as calm, as a deep inner tranquility and serenity. At the second level of oneness, your heart opens to feeling what others around you are feeling. You feel one with their joys and sorrows as if they were your own joys and sorrows.

The Ekam spiritual movement teaches that the ultimate foundation of existence is a singular, unified cosmic reality. This oneness implies that all perceived divisions, conflicts, and human suffering are ultimately illusory, arising from limited, fragmented perspectives rather than the true nature of the universe. The core wisdom of this teaching is that every perception of reality is inherently wise; the universe itself is perfect and conscious. To resolve global unrest and achieve true liberation, individuals must undergo a process of personal and collective awakening. By recognizing the interconnectedness of all existence and transcending the illusion of separation, humanity can align with this fundamental cosmic unity, manifesting a compassionate, peaceful, and enlightened consciousness that heals both the individual and the world.

Eam is a world center for enlightenment co-founded by Shri Priji and Shri Sri Krishnaji to catalyze a profound transition in human consciousness, shifting humanity from separation toward universal Oneness. The core vision is to cultivate a critical mass of 80,000 enlightened beings, specifically 800 enlightened leaders, to trigger a global phase transition. This spiritual mission aims to foster deep compassion, universal connection, and a lived experience of Oneness that transcends division and conflict. While millions of followers worldwide are currently on the path of Eam, the organization highlights that thousands have already successfully integrated this enlightened state into their daily lives. Ultimately, the striving and the vision of Eam are one, dedicated to empowering conscious organizational behavior and guiding humanity toward a unified, awakened existence.
